scientific_results.scope: Finite saved observations grouped by task, profile, numerical method and discretization. Different groups are not ranked against each other; unequal optimization budgets establish no causal or global optimum claim. Search summaries grant no formal SELECT/read credit.

control.control_source_scope: Initialized schedules are not physical passes. Measured inputs, predictions and unmeasured plans retain their origin; historical evidence grants no current execution permission. No source is selected.

formal_hypothesis.status: Main intent excerpts; not verified facts. Restore full text from the Plan.

current_research_state.scope: Descriptive current-Study facts, not a required research sequence. Historical Knowledge is not current task evidence.

mathematical_research.scope: Display order reflects constraint coverage, not cause or a required route. Other methods remain discoverable. Original authorization, source, scientific-input and budget admission still applies.

research_trace.recall: research_recall(step=<stable step>, view="summary" or "details"); omit step for paginated history.
research_trace.scope: Recorded actions and actual statuses only. Request acceptance, computation, verification and physical acceptance are distinct.

actions.reason: Candidate-registered control feasibility or structural research; T2 reuses saved T1 results.
actions.cost: Uses the shared mathematical allowance; inspect the method detail.

actions.reason: A suitable candidate, source, read, or other prerequisite is required.

tool_continuation.switch_tool: Use research_route only to change the loaded tool/action. Direct reads preserve the loaded Plan; selecting an entry alone executes nothing.

pending_feedback.scope: Deterministic Store projection of settled tools; delivery does not establish model understanding. Summary grants no complete-read credit.

scientific_action_handoff.next: Choose an action with research_route or record next_research_action in a new diagnose. Main owns the research choice.

read_progress.scope: Index delivery is not a full scientific result read or independent SELECT qualification.

evidence_access.select_requirement: Read acceptance_certificate for each exact fresh independently evaluated passing result; only complete deterministic certificate delivery on actual Provider wire or an exact full result read qualifies. Original source, fidelity, condition and confirmation admission still applies.
evidence_access.stop_requirement: Retrieve and cite the complete new result index; original admission checks remain in force.

citation_eligibility.rule: supporting_evidence requires registered result_reference matching inference, candidate, task and model scope. report_reference only restores Reporter text; Knowledge is procedural context; Domain Reference defines the problem; tool receipts record operations. None gains scientific eligibility by being read.

delegated_read.arguments: question and existing result references; optional exact reads
delegated_read.scope: Preferred for detailed numerical reading and comparison. Reporter reads never grant SELECT/STOP credit.

ScientificControlEffort.description: Scientific effort, compiled to the existing LocalControlSearchSettings.

knot_count.description: Uniform knots over the chosen adjustment window. Evaluation always covers the complete frozen task. Local windows require at least one interior knot; endpoint corrections remain zero.

iterations.description: Independent iteration cap. If omitted: min(callback cap, frozen Study iteration cap, original contract maximum). Early convergence can use fewer callbacks/iterations.

evaluation_requests.description: Maximum Native rollout callbacks per condition; separate from iterations and formal mathematical evaluation charges.

mode.description: C2 finite search parameterization: full_task adjusts all tendon channels with two independent endpoint knots over the frozen task; time_window adjusts all channels with one triangular pulse per channel and zero endpoint corrections. Choose a scope only when this parameterization answers the question; arbitrary waveform or channel-subset search is not adapted.

window_s.description: Only control corrections inside this interval; evaluation still covers the complete frozen task.

focus_metric.description: Registered task constraint ID or native observable; focus does not remove any frozen acceptance constraint.

numerical_method.description: Optional numerical identity from the current candidate catalog; Reach/Hold preserves its default T1 semantics. See analysis_handoff.control_methods for admission and scientific purpose.

dynamic_schema.description: Structure research uses structure operations inspect/differentiate/optimize/compare; control research uses control feasibility and effort. Joint structure-control search uses the existing research_plan(search) interface. Main owns all scientific choices.
